theme_strategy.concept: Warm Sambal Modernism (Indonesian Warung Contemporary POS)
theme_strategy.description: An appetite-stimulating, warm yet razor-sharp modern F&B POS palette designed for Kedai Mamah Livi. It moves away from generic harsh magenta/bubblegum pink to an artisanal Indonesian culinary palette: rich Sambal Red/Terracotta-Orange (#EA580C to #E11D48), warm Golden Turmeric (#F59E0B), fresh Pandan Leaf Green (#10B981) for success/online, and a warm stone background (#FAF9F6 / #F3F4F6) with deep charcoal-espresso (#18181B / #0F172A) high-contrast text.
theme_strategy.locale: id-ID (Rupiah 'Rp', 24-jam format WIB, Bahasa Indonesia natural warung phrasing)

rules.labels: font-sans uppercase text-xs font-bold tracking-wider text-zinc-500

entry_surfaces./: warm split hero & role portal — brand identity + live status banner top, quick POS launch button and role switchers (Kasir / Pemilik)
entry_surfaces./login: warm branded split login — Mamah Livi illustration & positioning left, high-contrast credential form right

desktop.sidebar: Fixed 240px left navigation with brand logo, live connection pill, navigation list, user profile + quick logout
desktop.pos_view: Two-column split: Left 65% product grid with sticky category filter pill bar and search input; Right 35% fixed height interactive cart drawer with summary, discount, customer note, and prominent 'Bayar' button
desktop.dashboard_view: Full fluid main container with 4 KPI summary cards, hourly transaction bar chart, and top 5 best seller items table

tablet.sidebar: Collapsible slim rail (72px) with icons and tooltips, expanding on hover/toggle
tablet.pos_view: Two-column compact split or slide-over sheet for cart with floating cart counter pill

mobile.sidebar: Hidden — replaced by ergonomic bottom navigation bar (Beranda, Kasir POS, Riwayat, Menu/Pengaturan)
mobile.pos_view: Single column product feed with horizontal scroll category chips, top search bar with barcode scanner icon, and bottom floating 'Keranjang (X Item) • Rp XX.XXX' sticky action bar opening a bottom drawer cart sheet
mobile.touch_targets: Minimum 48px x 48px touch bounding box on all buttons, steppers, and list items

add_to_cart_microinteraction.description: Card pops slightly (scale 0.96 -> 1.02 -> 1) with green check badge flash; cart badge counter bumps with spring animation

cash_payment_keypad.interactive_calculator: Numeric 3x4 grid for instant touch input with realtime 'Kembalian' (change) calculation and bold green indicator when cash >= total

audio_feedback.beep_sound: Optional Web Audio API synthesized soft 880Hz pleasant ping on barcode scan or item add (toggleable in Settings)
audio_feedback.success_chime: Pleasant two-tone chord on payment success

success_celebration.payment_success: Confetti blast + smooth receipt preview modal with 1-click thermal print (window.print() with 58mm/80mm receipt stylesheet) + WhatsApp share receipt button

offline_and_sync_indicator.pulse_dot: Pulsing green dot for Online & Synced, Amber for 'Offline Mode (Tersimpan Lokal di Dexie)', Orange spin badge when syncing

accessibility_and_testing.wcag_compliance: All body texts adhere strictly to APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio over card and page surfaces
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, filters, stepper +, stepper -, pay triggers, receipt buttons, cancel requests) must provide kebab-case testids: e.g. data-testid='pos-product-card-1', data-testid='cart-item-qty-inc', data-testid='btn-checkout', data-testid='payment-modal-cash-submit'

instructions_to_main_agent: Upgrade index.css with @theme tokens replacing generic harsh pink with warm culinary terracotta/orange (#EA580C) and amber (#F59E0B) as primary.
Import @fontsource-variable/outfit, @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans, and @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono in index.css for elite typography.

Ensure all pages (Login, POS, Owner Dashboard, Cashier Dashboard, Riwayat Transaksi, Menu Management, Kasir Management, Laporan, Pengaturan, Audit Log) use modern card containers, responsive layouts, and unified touch-friendly buttons.
Include quick numeric keypad in payment modal with instant 'Kembalian' calculation and quick nominal buttons (Uang Pas, 10k, 20k, 50k, 100k).
Implement bottom navigation bar on mobile viewports and floating sticky cart summary pill for effortless phone use in fast-paced warung service.
Add animated celebration + clear printable receipt modal on transaction completion.
Ensure Dexie offline status bar is clearly visible with pulsing indicator.
